name: What kind of water caused my garage flood, and why does it matter?

mainEntity.name: What kind of water caused my garage flood, and why does it matter?

acceptedAnswer.text: Floodwater is categorized into three types: Category 1 (clean water) from sources like burst pipes; Category 2 (grey water) from dishwashers or washing machines; and Category 3 (black water), which is highly contaminated from sewage, river overflows, or toilet backflows. The water category dictates the cleanup and safety protocols. Category 3 water, for example, requires specialized handling and disposal of affected porous materials due to severe health risks, making professional intervention essential.
acceptedAnswer.description: Water is categorized as clean, grey, or black; its type determines safety protocols and cleanup methods due to varying contamination levels and health risks.
